entities.name: Charles P. Hall
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lieutenant General Charles Philip Hall was a senior officer of the United States Army who fought in both World War I and World War II. He was the commander of XI Corps during World War II and the principal commander during the Battle of Bataan to liberate the Philippines from Japanese forces.
